# 041 CPU input and cache qualification results

**CPU_BOUNDARY_CONTRACT_REPRODUCED / LOCAL_COMPONENT_REGRESSION_ONLY.** One sealed formal run completed 36 pairs, 72 actual CPU boundary states, 288 sequences and 576 queries. This is unchanged ResponseCache plus an owned processor-marker backend, not lmms-eval CLI, its Qwen adapter, model inference, or answer accuracy.

## Actual boundary evidence

All 12 anticipated equal pairs and 24 different pairs passed direct key/type/dtype/shape/torch.equal comparisons independently of cache functions. Query preparation was separately recomputed and compared with oracle identity; no unstable state was selected away. Visual floats are final CPU BF16; integer inputs remain integer. Every state retains all kwargs, per-tensor continuous-byte hashes, full/visual/text identities, native token IDs and timecodes below. H includes fixed generation, processor/tokenizer configuration identity and runtime versions; no weight hash or model-execution claim.

Video grid is [6,12,18], 324 visual tokens; image grid [1,12,18], 54. Default native times are 0.5/2.5/4.5/6.5/8.5/10.5 seconds. FPS8 changes those to native rounded 0.2/1.2/2.2/3.2/4.2/5.2 while visual bytes stay equal. Shifted indices yield 1/3/5/7/9/11. Equivalent timeline and int4/float4 preserve the entire boundary. Pixel inversion and frame reversal change visual input; these are distinct from same-RGB timing changes. No token/grid edits were made.

## Measured costs

| Profile | Preprocess s | Boundary serialization s | Content hash s | Key/serialization inclusive s | SQLite C-call s | Query wall s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|UPSTREAM|0.351374|0.236352|0.000000|0.021163|1.675842|7.781681|
|SOURCE_NAMESPACE|0.603837|0.383835|0.175608|0.027398|1.690240|9.387379|
|EFFECTIVE_INPUT|0.609967|0.405487|0.000000|0.024727|1.710516|9.376988|
|NO_CACHE|0.622427|0.417174|0.000000|0.000000|0.000000|5.508612|

Every EFFECTIVE_INPUT query actually preprocesses before lookup (144 calls), including 24 hits; miss backend reuses only that same query preparation. SOURCE_NAMESPACE hashes complete fresh RGB, every metadata value, question, generation and configuration on all 144 queries, preprocessing only on misses. Oracle calls are an additional 72, not free query preprocessing. Timing is observed single-run CPU work, not installed-product/GPU speed. Non-mutating sys.setprofile observes original key/content/response-serialization Python calls and SQLite C calls; inclusive nested key times must not be summed with query wall or claimed as exclusive cycles. Preparation is excluded from cache profiling. Constructor/replay/open/close are included in query wall, same reopen lifecycle for all three cache profiles. Observer overhead and shared-machine load limit ranking.

Processor total **593/720** = suite4 + oracle72 + formal queries504 + clean13. Suite1/2 used, 17 actual assertions PASS; no second suite/API repair/smoke or historical test. Supervised wall 96.704000/1000s, formal 47.547000/600s, clean 10.657000/90s. Parent elapsed at evidence check 923.262/5400s (includes conservative pre-tool origin).

Before first output disk free 432658755584 bytes exceeded 32MiB+2GiB=2181038080. Two roots currently 37 files/1302111 bytes; no RGB/full tensors stored. Each sequence's owned DB/WAL/audit is discarded after its two-query receipt closes; at most one sequence DB is live. Counts/sizes here are resident snapshot, not cumulative write-volume telemetry or an atomic filesystem-quota proof. The policy limits writable paths, not a Windows disk quota; this instrumentation limitation is retained.

Every child was created suspended and assigned the reused public040 non-breakaway 4GiB Job before execution. Each phase accounted two Job members, one explicitly launched ML worker; all members actually reached active0 naturally, no termination or peer cleanup. CPU threads4, CUDA visibility empty before imports, CUDA is_initialized false at input and phase closure. Offline/local-only/trust_remote_code=False; audit rejects network/child launch, out-of-scope paths and weight body suffixes. No weights/model classes/forward/generate/GPU/device query, real annotation/QA/gold/old media/frames/predictions/private helper, download/decode/train/install or permanent environment/ACL/profile changes. No old config/ledger was opened.

Each successful marker is 77 UTF-8 bytes; 576 markers total 44,352 bytes. Output includes compact owned receipts and full anonymous CSV, not model responses. Job CPU/peak are phase measurements, not per-query Job sampling; query wall/processor/hash/SQLite costs are in the CSV.

[288 sequence CSV](cache-input-rows.csv) contains two canonical query records each, all 576 queries. `export ROOT CSV` reconstructs from closed rows and preserves any partial queries/NOT_RUN; `recompute CSV` independently aggregates without invoking processor or cache. The exported counts and every clean status/decision/marker matched the formal subset.
